reason: A is the stronger proposal because it adds a genuinely testable duplex intervention, includes single-treatment controls, and directly probes whether grading and compressive stress can improve bonding and mechanical stability beyond prior standalone treatments; B largely repeats the previously studied 8 wt% B4C Ni-based laser-cladding approach. However, A carries substantial risk because laser cladding will exceed 800 °C locally and may remelt or destroy the thin nitride layer, so preservation of that interface is the decisive mechanistic question.
